# AdScanVideo

> Analyze a video into timestamps, dialogue when available, shot descriptions, ad insights, production prompts, notes, or marketing copy.

AdScanVideo is a browser-based AI video analyzer for creators, editors, marketers,
agencies, researchers, and legal teams. It accepts MP4, MOV, WebM, and MKV uploads
or public HTTP(S) video links. No account is required.

## What it can produce

- Shot breakdown: timestamped shots, composition, lighting, camera movement, available dialogue, and prompts for recreating each shot
- Ad intelligence: hook, audience, structure, pacing, overlays, call to action, strengths, and improvements
- Podcast notes: speaker-aware segments, transcript-backed quotes, topics, and summary
- Marketing copy: captions, LinkedIn drafts, headlines, and promotional hooks
- Tutorial steps: timestamped actions, tools, tips, warnings, and a checklist
- Summary: chronology, people, key moments, visual style, tone, and intended audience

## Limits and accuracy

- Maximum video duration: 10 minutes
- Maximum uploaded file size: 200 MB
- Up to 20 selected frames are analyzed across the video
- Dialogue is included when captions or a usable audio transcript are available
- Some video platforms block server downloads; uploading the file is the reliable alternative
- Results are AI-generated and should be checked before legal, editorial, or production use
- Video and temporary audio, caption, and frame files are deleted after a job finishes, fails, or times out; analysis text and limited job and usage metadata are retained

## Pricing status

One analysis is free each day per network and resets at midnight UTC. Failed
analyses restore the allowance. A USD $3.99 single-analysis credit and a planned
$19/month option are displayed for transparency but cannot be purchased yet.
